study: Predeclared eBOSS DR16 A-03 empirical released-random LRG×ELG finite-bin conditional RR operator synthetic even-to-odd and odd-injection replay, NGC/SGC separately, 9 original fixed EZmocks
registered_before: First A-03 calculation/reinterpretation of nine-ID original NPZ matrix values or observed-random operator synthetic probe outputs under this protocol. Archived prior summary values and original pipeline synthetic probes may already exist; this test is not an independently selected realization cohort.

geometry.matrix_indices: observed_M_{cap}_out{o}_in{i}; mock_M_{cap}_id{mid:04d}_out{o}_in{i}; 10 blocks per cap and mock

frozen_probe_definitions.fine_midpoint: s_i=0.5*(fine_edges[i]+fine_edges[i+1]); coarse-bin center c_j=0.5*(coarse[j]+coarse[j+1]); width 20 h^-1 Mpc
frozen_probe_definitions.ramp: r(s_i) = (s_i - c_j)/20 within containing coarse bin, zero outside when applied to operator row j; all six coarse bins retained
frozen_probe_definitions.combined_probe: even_radial_ramp + odd_injection; exact sum of separately propagated vectors per all 18 mock cases and both observed-RANDOM operators, no theory fit or optimized amplitude

reported_descriptive_outputs: per cap observed-RANDOM operator (NOT observed galaxy odd) 6-bin ell1,ell3 constant-even, radial-even and odd-injection synthetic response vectors
per original fixed mock ID/cap same complete synthetic response vectors and differences from its observed-RANDOM operator
max_abs and L2 differences for even-ramp response and odd-injection response, plus original half-random ramp shift references with explicit correlation/nonindependence
the 18 preexisting synthetic unitless even-ramp comparisons from original JSON independently recomputed from exact npz matrices
max_abs constant-even residual, max absolute linear-superposition residual, exact positive RR support taken from original report
all original source/member SHA fingerprints, failing case and exact failure reasons, every 18 original case
local_output_mode: synthetic and original released random-only source artifact matrices; NO FITS downloaded or rows decoded; no user-local large raw mock inputs required
next_physical_validation_gate: A separate preregistered tracer-specific selection null/injection on actual mock-galaxy catalogues and large independent mock ensembles plus A-04 covariance before observed odd access.
